_about: Shared prompt fragments. Every image recipe is built as: subject sentence + world fragments + one framing fragment + the style fragment. Change these only with a decision entry; bump version when you do. Version 1 is the painterly anime action-RPG look chosen by the owner (decision 0014). No existing work, studio or artist is ever named.
style: High-end anime fantasy RPG key visual, stylised 3D look with painterly textures, soft cel shading with warm bounce light and cool rim light, detailed ornate equipment with engraved metal, layered cloth and leather, realistic proportions, expressive anime faces, lush bright colours with luminous highlights, original design, no photorealism, no text, no watermark, no logo.
style_v0: Cel-shaded anime game art, flat colours with two-tone shading, clean dark ink outlines on characters and objects, bright saturated palette, blue-violet shadows instead of black, soft clear daylight, simple readable shapes, strong silhouette, hand-painted look, no photorealism, no film grain, no text, no watermark, no logo.

framing.object_for_3d: A single object alone, centred, whole object in frame with margin, three-quarter view from slightly above, plain flat white background, even shadowless lighting, no ground, no hands, no extra objects.
framing.creature_for_3d: A single creature alone, centred, whole body in frame with margin, neutral standing pose, three-quarter front view, plain flat white background, even shadowless lighting, no ground, no scenery.
framing.character_sheet: Full-body character design, one person standing in a relaxed A-pose facing the viewer, whole body in frame from head to feet, plain flat white background, even lighting, anime proportions about seven heads tall, slightly large hands.
framing.landscape: Wide establishing shot, deep space, clear foreground, midground and background layers, big open sky.
framing.interior: Wide interior shot, readable depth, a few strong light sources, clear walkable floor.

world.godtree: Very far away, beyond a range of distant blue mountains that it dwarfs, rises one impossibly colossal world-sized tree, its trunk wider than the mountains, its vast crown spreading above the cloud layer, faded to pale hazy sky-blue by atmospheric distance, a faint silhouette in the sky, not near, not in the foreground.
world.motes: Small drifting points of warm gold light float in the air.
world.husk: A giant fallen seed husk, pale cream and tan, ribbed like a split walnut shell the size of a house.

palette_words: sky blue #6EC6FF, leaf green #7BE0A4, pale bark cream #E9DCC3, mote gold #FFD86B, meadow green #8FD14F, deep violet shadow #3B3A6E
